description: Mapping index from EltonTraits/AVONET rows to AviList v2025b species. Contains no trait values.

policy.avibase_id_semantics: An Avibase ID identifies one taxonomic concept (a circumscription cluster), not a name: a genus change or spelling change keeps the ID, a split or lump that changes the circumscription gets a new ID, and congruent concepts from different authorities share it (Lepage et al. 2014, ZooKeys 420:117-135, doi:10.3897/zookeys.420.7089; the Cornell Clements 'Taxon Concept Id' notes say the same). Equality of IDs is therefore treated as evidence of the same concept, but it is the curators' mapping, not an independent verification; partly overlapping concepts are the documented limit.
policy.avonet: accepted only when AVONET Avibase.ID1 equals the AvibaseID of exactly one AviList species and no other AVONET row shares that ID or the target name
policy.eltontraits: accepted only through the AVONET BirdLife-BirdTree crosswalk row with Match.type '1BL to 1BT' (both directions unique) -> that BirdLife species' unique Avibase.ID1 -> exactly one AviList species, Taxo BL3, no competing source row
policy.needs_review: candidate exists but is not proven (Taxo other than BL3, exact-name target with a different or unverifiable concept ID, competing source rows); alignment is not asserted to be a pre-split record
policy.unresolved: no candidate that satisfies the rules; trait rows stay unattached

schema.evidence: small object: ids/names/match types the decision used; null when nothing was matched
schema.method: 'avibase_id_unique' | 'birdtree_birdlife_avibase_chain' | 'exact_name_legacy' (needs_review candidate taken from the old exact-name rule) | null
schema.name_relation: accepted/needs_review with a target: 'same_name' | 'name_changed'; else null
schema.reason: null for accepted; otherwise a code from summary.reasons
schema.source_id: AVONET: Avibase.ID1 as written in the source. Elton: SpecID
schema.source_row: AVONET: row number in sheet AVONET1_BirdLife (header = row 1). Elton: line number in BirdFuncDat.txt (header = line 1)
schema.source_taxonomy: AVONET: 'HBW-BirdLife v5.0'. Elton: the Taxo column value (BL3 or IOC27)
schema.status: 'accepted' | 'needs_review' | 'unresolved'. Only 'accepted' may be used to attach source rows
schema.target_name: AviList Scientific_name of that species; for needs_review a candidate, not an approval
schema.target_sequence: AviList Sequence of the AviList species (null when no candidate)
schema.use: attach source rows only where status == 'accepted'; source values and percentages are never modified by this index

structure.avonet_birdlife_taxonomy: HBW-BirdLife v5.0 (Dec 2020), per AVONET Metadata sheet
structure.avonet_birdtree_taxonomy: Jetz et al. 2012 (BirdTree), per AVONET Metadata sheet

summary.note: Accepted counts move with the rules: Taxo other than BL3 and competing source rows are excluded from 'accepted' and appear under needs_review; 'name_changed' accepted entries are the additional recoveries over the old exact-name rule.
